questions.prompt: What is the smallest natural number ending in $6$ that becomes four times its original value when its last digit is moved to the front?
Which natural number has digit product equal to $x^2-10x-22$, where $x$ is the number itself?
What is the greatest product of positive integers whose sum is $1976$?
What is the maximum of $m^2+n^2$ for integers $m,n\in\{1,\ldots,1981\}$ satisfying $(n^2-mn-m^2)^2=1$?
Which set contains all triples $(a,b,p)$ of positive integers with prime $p$ satisfying $a^p=b!+p$?
For which real numbers $\alpha$ is $\sum_{k=1}^{n}\lfloor k\alpha\rfloor$ divisible by $n$ for every positive integer $n$?
